title: The Nocturne of Red Murderous Intent
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri posing as 'Morita', Ran, Inspector Megure, Detective Kobayashi) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed, attributed edge between the entities involved. The old wiki-derived case file at cases/ep180-181_the_nocturne_of_red_murderous_intent.json had the correct culprit (Misaki Kana) but several inaccuracies corrected here against the transcript: (1) it says Misaki met/dated Tenma 'in Hawaii' -- the transcript never mentions Hawaii; the attempted murder happened at an unnamed 'nearby beach', and the only named location tied to Misaki/Yoshinori's backstory is Fiji (their wedding, ten years ago). (2) it collapses the fake self-inflicted 'stalker' attack (staged by Misaki in her own bedroom during the party's opening blackout, using a fishing-line-rigged Beethoven bust) and the actual murder trap (a decorative sword suspended from the piano-room chandelier, triggered later that same night when Gerard Tenma picked up a planted tuning fork) into one event ('rigs a sword to fall... during a staged blackout stalker scene') -- these are two separate staged incidents, in two different rooms, using two different rigged objects, though built on the same fishing-line-and-weight-into-the-sea method, which is itself the clue that ties them together and unmasks Misaki. (3) it omits the victim's real name (Jun'ya Tenma), the reconciliation subplot (Tenma secretly rewrote the song's flower-code lyrics from a message of hatred to one of forgiveness before the contract signing, having realized his own 10-years-ago stalking of Misaki drove her to attack him), and the red-herring frame-up of Misaki's husband Yoshinori (accused by his own brother Hideki, who stood to gain control of the company either way). case_type: murder.

clues.desc: The fake 'caped stalker' rig demonstrated by Conan (a bust flown on a fishing pole from the balcony above Misaki's bedroom, dropped into the sea) reproduces the exact scrape-mark pattern and disposal method used in Tenma's murder trap -- since only Misaki could have staged the attack on herself, the shared method ties her to the murder rig too.

Everyone drank Michel's French wine at the toast except Misaki, who took juice instead -- yet wine matching that exact bottle (residue also found where Michel earlier bumped her brooch) stains the inside of the piano lid, proving she personally opened the piano lid despite her claimed alibi of never leaving the kitchen.

A photo secretly taken of the piano room the night before the party shows the Beethoven bust already missing from its usual spot, proving the fake-attack rig (and by extension the murder trap sharing its method) was prepared well before the blackout, not improvised in the dark.
